landing.h1: Ask a Vedic astrologer anything, in Hindi or English
landing.lead: Sidera reads your kundli and answers your questions about marriage, career, money and family. Same chat on WhatsApp, web and app.
landing.fact: Your first questions are free. No card needed.

how.d: Date, place and time if you know it. If you don't, pick morning, afternoon, evening or night.
Your birth chart, nakshatra and current dasha, worked out from real planetary positions.
Type the way you talk, in Hindi, English or Hinglish. Answers point to the houses and planets behind them.

landing.dailyLead: Each day's card is worked out from the panchang for your city: tithi, nakshatra, good hours and one line on what the day favours.
landing.chartH2: Your chart, the way your family reads it
landing.chartLead: North Indian or South Indian, chosen from where you were born. Switch any time.
landing.channelsLead: Start on WhatsApp, continue on the app, read back on the web. It's one conversation and one balance.
landing.priceH2: Pay only for what you ask
landing.priceLead: Top up when you need to. No subscription.

faq.a: Your details are used only to cast your chart and answer you. You can see what Sidera remembers and delete it, or delete your account, from your profile.

faq.q: Why do I log in with WhatsApp?
faq.a: You send a short code from your WhatsApp. That proves the number is yours without an SMS, and links your web, app and WhatsApp chats into one.

faq.q: I don't know my birth time.
faq.a: Pick the part of the day you were born. Sidera reads what can be read without it and tells you when a time would change the answer.

landing.footer: Sidera is made by KundliAI. Readings are guidance, not medical, legal or financial advice.

login.lead: One account for WhatsApp, web and app.
login.sendLead: Tap the button. WhatsApp opens with the code typed in. Just press send.
login.expired: That code expired. Get a new one.
login.locked: Too many tries. Try again in an hour.
login.noWhatsapp: Sidera needs WhatsApp to verify your number for now.
login.lostNumber: Lost your number? Use your backup email

onboarding.consentLead: Sidera uses your birth details to cast your chart. It can also remember things you tell it, so you don't have to repeat yourself.
onboarding.consentTerms: I agree to the terms and privacy policy
onboarding.consentMemoryHint: You can view and delete what it remembers any time.
onboarding.dobFuture: That date is in the future.
onboarding.timeH: Do you know your birth time?
onboarding.placeHint: If it's a village, pick the nearest town.
onboarding.interestsLead: Pick any. It helps Sidera know where to look first.
onboarding.emailLead: Optional. If you ever lose your number, this is how you get your account back.
onboarding.doneLead: A few more questions make answers sharper. It takes two minutes.

home.dailyLocked: Top up to read the full card
home.referLead: When they verify, you both get credits.

credits.label: Credits
credits.pendingLead: This can take a minute. You can leave this page.

chat.title: Chat
chat.error: That didn't go through. Try again. No credit was used.
chat.textOnly: Text only for now. Voice and photos are coming.
chat.blocked: You're out of credits. Top up to keep asking.
chat.incognitoOn: Incognito on. Nothing from this chat is remembered.

friends.lead: See how today looks for the people you care about.
friends.empty: No friends yet. Add someone with their birth date.
friends.name: Name

profile.birthNote: You can change these once a day.
profile.clearChatNote: Clears recent messages. What Sidera remembers stays.
profile.deleteAccountNote: Your account is removed after 7 days. Log in before then to cancel.
